description: This file defines the internal sealed class ActivationRebalancerMonitor, which implements monitoring and management functionalities for activation rebalancing within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for starting, stopping, reporting, and subscribing to rebalancer reports, as well as internal logic for scheduling and handling rebalancing tasks.

classes.name: ActivationRebalancerMonitor
classes.description: A class responsible for monitoring and managing activation rebalancing in Orleans, including scheduling, reporting, and listener notification functionalities.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the monitor to lifecycle events for start and stop.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Initializes the monitor, sets up timers, and fetches initial reports.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Handles cleanup and potential migration of the rebalancer during shutdown.

methods.name: GetRebalancingReport
methods.description: Retrieves the current rebalancing report, optionally forcing an update.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Updates the latest report and notifies all registered listeners.

methods.name: SubscribeToReports
methods.description: Adds a listener for rebalancing reports.

methods.name: UnsubscribeFromReports
methods.description: Removes a listener from rebalancing report notifications.
